recent_excerpts: Latvia's LVM says 44 GB of data leaked, two-thirds of customers still locked out of systems after ransomware attack attributed to a foreign financially motivated group.
Notion public pages expose the email addresses and profile photos of all editors, a flaw affecting millions of users of the collaboration platform.

Freelance platform Fiverr exposed sensitive user files, including tax documents and PII, via a misconfigured cloud storage bucket, with data indexed by Google search, according to security researchers
